budget_used.description: Approved minutes over the hours budget, a percentage to one decimal.

direct_costs.description: Project-tagged posted costs on expense accounts WITHOUT the payroll-cost flag (FR-COA-02), in the base currency.

margin.description: Revenue less time at cost less direct costs; absent when the time has no cost to use.

payroll_tagged.description: Project-tagged lines on payroll-cost accounts: listed to reconcile, never in direct costs, so salary tagged to a project is not counted twice (G4-049).

rate_basis.description: Where the time cost's rates came from.

realisation.description: Billed (revenue) over standard value, a percentage to one decimal.

revenue.description: Revenue posted to the project in the months, from posted ledger lines on revenue accounts, in the base currency.

standard_value.description: Billable time at billing rates, in the base currency, when the project is billed in it.

time_cost.description: Approved time at the viewer's cost rate (RND-TIME per entry); absent when no rate may be used.
